rows.title_full: AN ACT ENJOINING ALL PERSONS WHO ARE PHYSICALLY PRESENT DURING THE PLAYING OR SINGING OF THE PHILIPPINE NATIONAL ANTHEM TO STAND ON ATTENTION, AND PROVIDING FOR PENALTY IN CASE OF A VIOLATION
rows.abstract: Seeks to enjoin all persons, except those who are incapacitated or handicapped, to stand at attention during the playing or singing of the Philippine National Anthem. Aims to develop a sense of patriotism, nationalism and love for one's country.

rows.author: A034
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE TEACHING OF ECOLOGY IN ALL ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY LEVELS, WHETHER PUBLIC OR PRIVATE, OF THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Includes the teaching of ecology in all elementary and high school levels. Is intended to promote environmental consciousness and vigilance which is a conditiosine qua non to a holistic education required under the New Constitution. Directs the Secretary of DECS to issue the necessary reading materials dealing with the subject in relation to the pressing environmental issues in the country.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on EDUCATION AND CULTURE since 1995-08-08

rows.author: A054
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE SYSTEM TO ESTABLISH A STUDY-NOW-PAY-L ATER PROGRAM FOR MEMBERS AND THEIR DEPENDENTS WHO DESIRE TO PURSUE COLLEGE EDUCATION
rows.abstract: Entitles any GSIS member or his dependent to enroll in any college or university with his tuition and matriculation fees and other allowable expenses to be paid by the GSIS until he completes the course of his choice. States that grantees of the program shall begin to amortize their payment beginning on the THIRD YEAR AFTER THEIR GRADUATION. Grants valedictorians and salutatorians of public secondary shools full scholarship under this Act.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08561

rows.author: A054
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE GOVERNMENT SERVICE INSURANCE SYSTEM TO DEVELOP HOUSING COMMUNITIES FOR ITS MEMBERS IN PROVINCES AND CITIES THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY
rows.abstract: Mandates GSIS to undertake and develop low-cost housing communities in provinces and cities throughout the country for the next five (5) years. Ensures that all qualified GSIS members are given the opportunity to avail of a unit on a soft loan basis.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08561

rows.author: A007
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE INCREASE OF THE AUTHORIZED CAPITAL STOCK OF THE NATIONAL ELECTRIFICATION ADMINISTRATION AND ORDAINING THE ENERGIZATION OF ALL BARANGAYS, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NUMBERED TWO HUNDRED AND SIXTY-NINE, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'NATIONAL ELECTRIFICATION ADMINISTRATION DECREE'
rows.abstract: Increases the capitalization of the National Electrification Administration (NEA) from [five (5) Billion] to TWENTY-FIVE BILLION PESOS (P25 Billion). Aims to energize all barangays within the next 15 years by further extending financial assistance to the rural electric cooperatives. Allows the conversion into equity of all advances by the National Treasury for NEA's foreign loans and for its outstanding liabilities for rural electrification projects.
rows.status: Substituted by HB02356

rows.author: A064
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROMOTE THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE FARMERS IN THE BURLEY AND NATIVE TOBACCO-PRODUCI NG PROVINCES, PROVIDING FOR THE AUTOMATIC APPROPRIATION OF THE FUNDS THEREIN AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Recognizes active participation of tobacco farmers in the generation of revenues for the government through excise taxes from cigars and cigarettes. Seeks, therefore, to uplift these farmers from their present economic bondage, enhance their productivity and market potential, and accord them the much-needed opportunity for advancement and self-reliance.
rows.status: Consigned to the Archives on 1996-12-12

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE ASSIGNMENT, CONVEYANCE AND TRANSFER TO THE PROVINCIAL OR CITY GOVERNMENT CONCERNED OF ASSETS ACQUIRED AND HELD FOR OVER FIVE (5) YEARS BY GOVERNMENT FINANCING INSTITUTIONS FOR MONETIZATION OR DISPOSAL, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Acquired Assets Monetization Act of 1995" Seeks to fully utilize the sale of idle acquired government assets by requiring all government financing institution to assign, convey and transfer such assets held for oever five (5) years to the provincial or city government concerned. Allocates the proceeds of the monetized or disposed assets as follows:  (1) 30% for the national government; (2) 30% for the provincial/city government; and (3) 30% and 10% respectively for the municipality and barangay where these assets are located.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BANKS AND FINANCIAL INTERMEDIARIES since 1995-08-08
